title: Ragging: what to do
summary: What counts as ragging, the consequences, and the 24×7 helpline.

posts.md:
IIT Madras follows a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging. Every student has the right to feel safe on campus. If you experience or witness ragging, report it immediately—your identity and safety are taken seriously.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What Counts as Ragging?

Ragging includes any behavior that humiliates, threatens, or harms another student, including:

Mental, physical, or sexual abuse
Verbal abuse or insulting language
Indecent or humiliating behavior
Criminal intimidation or wrongful restraint
Financial exploitation or extortion
Any act that undermines a student's dignity

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Consequences of Ragging

Students found involved in ragging may face one or more of the following actions:

Cancellation of admission
Suspension from attending classes
Withdrawal of scholarships or fellowships
Debarment from representing IIT Madras in competitions, tournaments, or festivals
Collective disciplinary action if the individuals responsible cannot be identified

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Need Help?

If you experience or witness ragging, contact any of the following immediately:

24×7 Ragging Helpline: 044-2257-9999
Alternate Number: 044-2257-8280
Email: secsec@iitm.ac.in

You can also reach out to:

Your Hostel Warden
Chairman/Vice Chairman, Council of Wardens (CCW)
DoST (Dean of Students) Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Senior's Advice
Save the ragging helpline number on your phone before arriving on campus.
If something feels uncomfortable, don't assume it's "normal" or "part of college life." Report it early.
If a friend is being ragged, encourage them to seek help—you can report incidents even as a witness.
